summary: Build practical skills in psychosocial hazard assessment, controls, and monitoring. Explore the five-day course and its applied work products.
lede: Psychosocial hazard risk assessment helps OHS, HR, occupational health, and line-management professionals identify, evaluate, and control work-related risks. Training applies ISO 45003 guidance within an ISO 45001 system context, with practice in assessing work design and workload, creating a prioritized hazard register, and establishing consultation, incident-response, and monitoring measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess work-related psychosocial hazards, implement controls, advise managers, or provide assurance on occupational health and safety systems.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational work processes and an OHS, HR, occupational health, employee-relations, or line-management responsibility is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software if you want to build the course dashboard digitally.
